steps.label: Packs laden
steps.run: mkdir -p "$AGENT_HOME/sfx" && cd "$AGENT_HOME/sfx" && for p in impact-sounds rpg-audio casino-audio interface-sounds digital-audio ui-audio; do i=$(printf "assets/$p" | xxd -p | tr -d '\n'); u=$(curl -sS -f -m 30 -A "Mozilla/5.0" "https://kenney.nl/download-link/$i" | sed -E 's/.*"url":"([^"]+)".*/\1/' | sed 's#\\/#/#g'); curl -sS -f -m 120 -A "Mozilla/5.0" -o "$p.zip" "$u" && mkdir -p "$p" && unzip -q -o "$p.zip" -d "$p" && echo "$p ok"; done; find . -name "*.ogg" | wc -l; tar czf kenney_all.tgz impact-sounds rpg-audio casino-audio interface-sounds digital-audio ui-audio; ls -la kenney_all.tgz
